title: Engineering over panic: Jensen Huang's pragmatic vision for the future of AI
content: In a 46-minute interview on CBS, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang pushed back against apocalyptic warnings regarding artificial intelligence (AI). He urged the industry to focus on rigorous engineering and safe product delivery rather than apocalyptic fearmongering.

content: Foxtron Vehicle Technologies said its overseas expansion is taking shape as exports to New Zealand and Australia enter their final countdown, with a planned Poland factory with ElectroMobility Poland also drawing attention. title: YMTC wins German injunctions against Micron in latest round of NAND patent battle
content: Micron is facing fresh pressure on multiple fronts after Germany's Munich I Regional Court sided with Chinese memory maker YMTC and issued two injunctions over alleged infringement. Industry sources said enforcement of the injunctions could restrict Micron's supply in Germany and reshape the European automotive and industrial-control NAND market.

title: Automotive display growth shifts to HUDs, passenger screens
content: The global automotive display market is entering a new phase of growth, with demand shifting away from central consoles and instrument clusters toward niche applications such as head-up displays (HUDs) and front-passenger entertainment panels. title: LG Electronics, Microsoft enter partnership on AI data centers, physical AI
content: LG Electronics entered a partnership with Microsoft to cooperate on a range of AI initiatives. The two firms agreed to work together on AI data centers, LG Electronics' AI data transformation, and physical AI as the company known for appliances taps into growing AI-related industries.

title: Samsung Display explores halftone black PDL tech to cut OLED production costs
content: Samsung Display is evaluating a new manufacturing process known as halftone black pixel definition layer (PDL) that could streamline the production of its OLED panels, industry sources disclosed to The ELEC on September 22. By integrating two separate manufacturing steps into a single photolithography process, the display maker aims to reduce costs and boost efficiency for upcoming flagship devices.

title: Samsung LPDDR6 validated by Qualcomm for next-gen Snapdragon platform
content: AI workloads are pushing cloud, edge, and mobile devices toward tighter power budgets and heavier data traffic, making memory efficiency a growing global issue. Samsung is positioning its new LPDDR6 as a response, with higher bandwidth, lower power use, and improved reliability for next-generation on-device AI.

title: Biwin Storage commits US$672M to double down on 2.5D packaging, compute-memory integration
content: Biwin Storage Technology plans to invest CNY4.5 billion (approx. US$672 million) in the third phase of its wafer-level advanced packaging and testing project, expanding 2.5D integration and compute-memory co-packaging capacity as AI and high-performance computing lift demand for advanced packaging.

title: China's BeiDou eyes US$150 billion industry scale with AI, services at the core
content: China's BeiDou satellite navigation industry continues to expand rapidly, with applications spreading from chips and modules to end devices. Emerging technologies including artificial intelligence are increasingly being integrated with BeiDou, while the industry is shifting from hardware sales towards data, platforms, and services. Overseas markets are also emerging as a key source of future growth.

title: ZDT prices US$800M ECB to expand AI server PCB push
content: Printed circuit board (PCB) maker Zhen Ding Technology (ZDT) Group completed pricing of its sixth overseas convertible bond issue on September 22, raising a total of US$800 million (about NT$25.224 billion). The company plans to issue the bonds on September 29 and list them on the Singapore Exchange, with proceeds to be used entirely to replenish working capital and support technology development for high-end products.

title: Taiwan's Master Bus scales 450 kW direct-drive motor for the intercity EV market
content: Master Transportation Bus Manufacturing (Master Bus) is deepening its electric-bus strategy around proprietary motors and chassis.

title: Hermes-Epitek eyes CPO test revenue in 2027
content: Archie Hwang, the founder and chairman of Hermes-Epitek, appeared before the media alongside Hermes Testing Solutions Inc. (HTSI) executives. The company outlined a major push into silicon photonics (SiPh) co-packaged optics (CPO) testing and said related revenue is expected to begin contributing in 2027.

title: LG Energy enters Nvidia's ecosystem as it pivots batteries to data centers
content: LG Energy's battery energy storage system (BESS) has entered Nvidia's AI Factory ecosystem. Its qualification by the chipmaker comes as LG Energy is reorienting its North American battery plants toward data centers and appears poised to capture fresh demand after the US imposed restrictions on Chinese battery imports.
